name: High Country Orchard
description: High Country Orchard grows Peaches, Nectarines, Apricots, Plums, and Cherries in Colbert, WA. The farm is family-run, and its seasons run through summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Sep in this growing zone.
